title: Interest on a carried card balance, a loan and a pay-later plan (decision I2)
story: The same life as loans_and_carried.json, now with yearly rates. One bank, set up Thu 26 Nov 2026 with 500,000, the day after pay. Pay of 300,000 on the 25th, moved earlier. A car loan of 1,000,000 at 18% a year is paid on the 5th (moved later): the minimum is 2% of what is owed, at least 10,000, and from 1 Jan 2027 an extra 5,000 is planned each time. A pay-later plan has 30,000 left at 15% a year, 10,000 a month on the 15th (moved later). A card that carries a balance, at 15% a year, closes on the 20th and is paid on the 10th of the next month (moved later): the minimum is 5% of the statement, at least 3,000, and an extra 2,000 is planned from 1 Dec. Its 100,000 statement of 20 Nov is not paid yet. All three are paid from the bank. The January car loan payment has not been seen by 6 Jan. I2: interest is added on the carried balance at each card close and on each loan and pay-later payment day, balance x yearly rate / 12, rounded half up to the yen. On a payment day the interest is added first, then the payment is asked on what is owed. A minimum of 5% or 2% is rounded to the nearest yen, as before. No holidays are listed. Every amount and rate is made up.

cc.why: 93,000 carried (100,000 statement - 7,000 paid) x 15 / 100 / 12 = 1,162.5, rounded half up

asks.question: due_before_next_pay
asks.why: 20,300 (car loan: 2% of 1,015,000, the 1,000,000 owed plus 15,000 interest on 7 Dec) + 7,000 (card: 5% of the 100,000 statement and the planned 2,000 extra) + 10,000 (pay-later part) = 37,300
asks.note: Before I2 the car loan asked 20,000.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 500,000 (Bank today) - 20,300 (Car loan 7 Dec) - 7,000 (Card that carries 10 Dec) - 10,000 (Pay-later 15 Dec) = 462,700
asks.note: The 25 Dec pay of 300,000 comes before the January payments (25,192, 6,708 and 10,000), so the lowest point is 15 Dec.

asks.question: owed_now
asks.why: 1,000,000 (owed at setup) + 15,000 (interest at the 7 Dec payment day) - 20,300 (paid 7 Dec) = 994,700

asks.question: owed_now
asks.why: 30,000 (left at setup) + 375 (interest at the 15 Dec payment day) - 10,000 (paid 15 Dec) = 20,375

asks.question: owed_now
asks.why: 100,000 (statement 20 Nov) - 7,000 (paid 10 Dec) + 1,163 (interest at the 20 Dec close on the 93,000 carried, 1,162.5 rounded half up) + 10,000 (spent 12 Dec) = 104,163

asks.question: card_due
asks.why: 5,208 (5% of the 104,163 statement is 5,208.15, to the nearest yen) + 2,000 (planned extra) = 7,208
asks.note: Before I2: 7,150, on a 103,000 statement with no interest.

asks.question: due_before_next_pay
asks.why: 25,192 (car loan: 2% of 1,009,621, the 994,700 owed plus 14,921 interest, is 20,192.42, to the nearest yen 20,192, plus the 5,000 extra from 1 Jan) + 7,208 (card) + 10,000 (pay-later, on 20,630 owed after 255 interest) = 42,400

asks.question: owed_now
asks.why: 994,700 (owed after the December payment) + 14,921 (interest at the 5 Jan payment day, 14,920.5 rounded half up) = 1,009,621
asks.note: The January payment has not been seen; the interest is added on the payment day all the same.
